blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Police arrested a 44-year-old man classified as a high-value drug suspect and seized more than P404,000 worth of suspected shabu during a buy-bust operation in Polomolok, South Cotabato, on Thursday night, Oct. 15. Police Regional Office 12 (PRO-12) identified the suspect only as alias “Andy,” a resident of Barangay Poblacion, where the operation took place around 9:04 p.m. According to Maj Robert Fores, PRO-12 information officer, the Polomolok Municipal Police Station, in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Region 12, recovered four sachets of suspected shabu weighing about 58.92 grams, with an estimated value of P404,191.20.
